text:
[ANCHOR 1]
Hey, RedWolves! I'm [ANCHOR 1].

[ANCHOR 2]
And I'm [ANCHOR 2]. It's the last week before Thanksgiving Break, and we have a lot to cover. Coming up, we've got school news, your weather, and Student Voices.

[CUE INTRO SEQUENCE]

[ANCHOR 1]
First up, here's what's going on. Wednesday is Education Support Professionals Day. It's a day to thank the people who keep our schools running, like custodians, cafeteria workers, and bus drivers.

[ANCHOR 2]
They really do keep everything going.

[ANCHOR 1]
Then on Thursday, it's National Parental Involvement Day. It's a day to thank the parents and families who help out at school and at home.

[ANCHOR 2]
Thanks, [ANCHOR 1]. And that night, the La Joya ISD Conjunto Showcase starts at 6:30 p.m. [VERIFY: location] It's a great way to support our student musicians. And to close out the week, Friday is Substitute Appreciation Day. Substitute teachers step in when our teachers are out, and they help keep our classes going.

[ANCHOR 1]
Mark your calendars. Next week is Thanksgiving Break, so there's no school Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27. Classes start back up Monday, November 30.

[ANCHOR 2]
[ADD CAMPUS STORY: Jimmy Carter news or an RGN package]
Up next, [WEATHER REPORTER] with the weather. Don't go anywhere.

[CUE BUMPER]

[WEATHER]
Hey, RedWolves! I'm [WEATHER REPORTER]. Let's take a look at this week's weather forecast!
We're starting the week off mild on Monday, with a high of 72 degrees. Expect partly sunny skies, a morning low of 64, and no rain.
Tuesday stays about the same, with a high of 71. Expect partly sunny skies, a morning low of 58, and no rain.
Wednesday warms up to 77 degrees. Expect mostly cloudy skies, a morning low of 62, and no rain.
Thursday warms up to 80 degrees. Expect mostly cloudy skies, a morning low of 68, and a 12 percent chance of rain.
Friday warms up to 83 degrees. Expect mostly cloudy skies, a morning low of 70, and a 10 percent chance of rain.
Have a great week, RedWolves!

[CUE BUMPER]

[CUE STUDENT VOICES]

[MENU]
Hey, RedWolves! Here's what's cookin' this week.
On Monday, breakfast is Hawaiian Sandwich. For lunch, it's Pulled Pork Burger, plus Ranch Style Beans, Onion Rings and Burger Salad.
On Tuesday, breakfast is Kolache. For lunch, it's Cherry Blossom Chicken with Fried Rice and Egg Roll, plus Carrot Coins and Broccoli with Queso.
On Wednesday, breakfast is Buttery Maple Waffle. For lunch, it's VIP Turkey with Dinner Roll, plus Mashed Potato with Gravy and Golden Corn.
On Thursday, breakfast is Pancake on a Stick. For lunch, it's Chili and Cheese, plus Hot Dog, Tater Tots and Carrot Coins.
On Friday, breakfast is Assorted Cereal with Cracker. For lunch, it's Pizza with Wings, plus Baby Carrots and Garden Salad.
Enjoy your meals, RedWolves!

[ANCHOR 1]
That's it for this week's RGN. Remember, there's no school next week for Thanksgiving Break. We'll see you back on November 30.

[ANCHOR 2]
Thanks for watching. Have a safe and happy Thanksgiving, RedWolves!

[CUE OUTRO]
